review.design: Reuse the existing wheel payload manifest, one ResourceSet resolver, one explicit external layout and the retained legacy branch. No new dependency or resource registry.
findings_resolved: Partial config/lock selection now refuses fallback to repository copies.
Recheck selection and payload before returning bytes or writing artifacts.
Reject linked resource inputs and source-tree fallback.
List resources with one final identity check instead of rehashing the full payload for every returned member.

git diff --check initially returned 2 because six touched source files retained checkout CRLF while this command used core.autocrlf=false. Restored LF only on those edited source files, matching their committed baseline; installed policy and other files remain unchanged.
Qualification runner now resolves its own paths before changing subprocess cwd.

Candidate runtime identity uses candidate-package semantics; released-evaluator digest flags were correctly refused and removed from that test invocation. Independent wheel digests remain checked through the resource query.
Offline test runner uses the real module argv path; the identity guard correctly refused the earlier pretend console entry point.
Draft authoring fixture now supplies an existing unapproved governing chain rather than invalid empty relation arrays. No candidate code change was needed for these fixture corrections.
remaining: Approval and implementation of WO-IAR-031 result wiring.
Public lifecycle result parity through the wired discovery route.
Complete handoff and exact-candidate verification preparation; no VREC has been prepared.
